meta.name: Taranath Tantrik 720p
meta.description:
Dig in the mystery of Taranath Tantrik as you experience the other-world with him. Directed by Q, the web-series promises horror like never before.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Taranath Tantrik
videos.overview: The time is 1930s. Two young men in Kolkata are trying to explore the city amidst the social unrest, till they find the den of the mysterious Taranath Tantrik

videos.title: Matu Pagli
videos.overview: Taranath is asked to share his experiences while struggling to learn the art of pagan practices. He narrates his encounter with his first guru, Matu Pagli.

videos.title: Subala
videos.overview: Days pass as Taranath gradually starts to feel the presence of supernatural traits during few instances. One such instance leads him to a young girl.

videos.title: Jawrashur
videos.overview: Taranath shares his first experience of learning about Tantric practices as a child when he was affected by an incurable disease.

videos.title: Betal
videos.overview: Taranath narrates how, during his days of practising Tantra, he was assigned the tough task of saving a young girl from a Kapalik. Was his attempt successful?

videos.title: Kalbhairav
videos.overview: Taranath recounts how he earned the attention of Kalbhairav with his unceasing efforts, but failed miserably at a crucial moment during his practice.

videos.title: Birajbala
videos.overview: Taranath talks about his experience of sensing the presence of an unusual being during his visit to his home after spending years as a wanderer.

videos.title: Tarabhoirobi
videos.overview: Taranath recalls how he was smitten by an enchantress at a young age, and narrates the series of baffling incidents which followed soon after.

videos.title: Madhsundari Debi
videos.overview: While recounting the experiences of his youth, Taranath narrates the tale of his encounter with a young woman named Madhusundari.

videos.title: Bathtob
videos.overview: Taranath describes his experience of getting invited to a rich man's house where he sensed an other-worldly presence. Did he use his power of exorcism?
